population_definition: registered-export session keys with core_ready = true: not quarantined, at least one modellable event, no ERROR finding, valid weights, parsed times
interpretation: Typical DERIVED selected meal weight in the approved measurement population.
limitation: DERIVED from weighing events at the line; one population; five weeks; cannot be read as intake.

population_definition: registered-export session keys with core_ready = true: not quarantined, at least one modellable event, no ERROR finding, valid weights, parsed times
interpretation: Upper end of the DERIVED selected meal weight distribution.
limitation: the most period-sensitive metric; describes five weeks; DERIVED, not intake.

population_definition: registered-export session keys with core_ready = true: not quarantined, at least one modellable event, no ERROR finding, valid weights, parsed times
grain: one session key (session_id|registered_export); per service date in the supporting table
interpretation: How many registered-export sessions were observed, are valid and feed M1, M2 and M4.
limitation: an observation of the export; the weekday pattern and six irregular days mean it must not be read as restaurant volume.

metric_name: Median Distinct Normalized Components per Session
population_definition: registered-export session keys with core_ready = true: not quarantined, at least one modellable event, no ERROR finding, valid weights, parsed times
interpretation: How many different named components a typical session selected.
limitation: counts names within a session; no alias table, so different spellings of one dish would count separately; comparison of components across exports is limited on some days.

population_definition: every registered-export session key, counted before any quarantine or removal
interpretation: Share of eligible registered-export sessions meeting the approved core measurement readiness criteria.
limitation: high because few registered-export sessions carry an ERROR finding, not because the data is proven error-free; weather, WARN rules and volume flags never enter it.

population_definition: every registered-export session key, counted before any quarantine or removal
interpretation: Coverage of the contextual weather join (next full UTC hour after the first weighing; r_1h is the hour ending at its timestamp).
limitation: context only; regional station roughly 6 km away; the Phase 2 dry run matched all 1,697 core-ready sessions and expected the two quarantined sessions to be joined too, which the model deliberately does not do.

population_definition: every registered-export session key, counted before any quarantine or removal
interpretation: Share of eligible registered-export sessions with no session-level warning.
limitation: a diagnostic of how many sessions carry a WARN, not a data-quality score; it differs from M5 because a WARN never removes a session from the KPIs.

metric_name: Warn-Free Rate incl. Event-Level Warnings (diagnostic variant)
population_definition: every registered-export session key, counted before any quarantine or removal
formula: 100 * COUNT(core_ready AND NOT has_session_warn AND NOT has_event_warn) / COUNT(C)
interpretation: Reconciliation of S2 to the event-level view (three sessions differ). It never replaces S2.
limitation: diagnostic only; reported so the S2 definition is transparent.

formula: none: there is no formula, no estimate and no proxy
interpretation: No direct waste metric is computed. derived_selected_meal_weight_g is not waste and is not used as a proxy.
limitation: permanent unless a public raw waste dataset is found.
